verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's core outputs (markdown, plain text, JSON) are inherently open, portable formats rather than proprietary lock-in, and BYOC self-hosting lets users run the entire platform on their own infrastructure with full data control (docs-7, docs-17, docs-24). However, there's no explicit documented bulk 'export all account data' or account-deletion/migration feature—evidence only covers per-document output formats and self-hosting, not a comprehensive data-export mechanism. missing for 10: explicit account-level bulk export tooling, data-deletion/migration guarantees, independent confirmation of portability beyond docs.
